enchantments.tooltip: +8 Enhancement Bonus: +8 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Electrifying 5: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 5d6 Lightning damage on each hit.
Jolting 12: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 12d6 Lightning damage on each critical hit.
Insightful Seeker +5: Provides a +5 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +5 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
